shared_elements: animal figure with schematic, simplified body
prominent large eye and head shown in profile

justification: Both surfaces depict schematic animals reduced to blocky bodies with an oversized eye and simple limbs, and both carry a net-like crosshatched geometric field (a woven band in A, a mesh over the neck/shoulder in B). The biggest difference is compositional: A is a multi-register narrative crowd of birds, a scorpion-like creature, a small human and repeated arched signs stacked in bands, whereas B shows a single massive predator-headed creature isolated as a volumetric figure with no accompanying scene.
